notes.title: Detective adventure Backbone looks incredible and launches on June 8
notes.content:
After a successful Kickstarter campaign back in 2018, the Backbone: Prologue release in 2019, we're about to see Backbone officially launch on June 8.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/05/detective-adventure-backbone-looks-incredible-and-launches-on-june-8

notes.title: Noir roleplaying detective adventure Backbone is 'content complete' with a new trailer
notes.content:
With a free Prologue available to try out right now, developer EggNut has announced that Backbone is pretty much content complete.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/10/noir-roleplaying-detective-adventure-backbone-is-content-complete-with-a-new-trailer
